<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, touching **11** documentable anchor(s).

**19** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json efa2915e4c2dc1d5bd09bedbd4eef9bc31cb9fe6`.

⛔ **11** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **4** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json efa2915e4c2dc1d5bd09bedbd4eef9bc31cb9fe6` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `87e015dccc0f2c38c594c63e59e5f60369bf0181` — the merge of head `78e68ad43b69cdfc71665680aa652e25e3635ccc` into base `efa2915e4c2dc1d5bd09bedbd4eef9bc31cb9fe6`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 87e015dccc0f2c38c594c63e59e5f60369bf0181 && git checkout 87e015dccc0f2c38c594c63e59e5f60369bf0181
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin efa2915e4c2dc1d5bd09bedbd4eef9bc31cb9fe6 78e68ad43b69cdfc71665680aa652e25e3635ccc && git checkout -B drift-repro efa2915e4c2dc1d5bd09bedbd4eef9bc31cb9fe6 && git merge --no-ff 78e68ad43b69cdfc71665680aa652e25e3635ccc

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json efa2915e4c2dc1d5bd09bedbd4eef9bc31cb9fe6
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs efa2915e4c2dc1d5bd09bedbd4eef9bc31cb9fe6` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

epic:#27261#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2c5z3q4h8inrn5kwqV
REWORK round 1 · PR #27639 @ `4e9b79ca` · 2026-10-29T16:01Z

The seat review and an independent full Fable review agree.

## Must fix

1. **The hint still recommends `'private'` where `'private'` reads no rows.** On `security-owd-unset`'s side, `externalOwnershipGap` exempts an object on a datasource declared `external.allowWrites: false`, which keeps "`'private'` … recommended". On `main` since #27476, `buildReadFilter` answers deny-all on `private` whenever the owner anchor is a phantom (`hasPhantomOwnerAnchor`: `external != null` plus owner provenance). Writability and `allowWrites` play no part, so a member following the hint reads zero rows.
   - The exemption is also inconsistent across doors. The posture rule runs at the publish gate, whose `RuntimeStackContext` carries no `datasources`, so `os lint` and the 422 door disagree on that shape.
   - **Fix:** keep the datasource exemption in `security-external-owner-unmapped` only, where it is about who refuses a write. `security-owd-unset` judges the read-side fact: an external object with no provable owner anchor (no declared owner field, no `columnMap` onto it) never gets `'private'` recommended.
     - Writable binding: the external rule's two ways out, as now.
     - Read-only binding (`writable` not `true`, or `allowWrites: false`): recommend `'public_read'`, the guide's own advice (`virtual-objects.mdx`, the read-only example).
   - Flip the `allowWrites: false` test row, add a read-only-binding row, and rewrite the `os explain` sentence (`rule-explanations.ts` ~:124-125) that says such an object "keeps the usual fix line".
2. **Stale header** at `validate-external-owner-sharing.ts:41-43`: it still says the injected owner "leaves reads unscoped". Since #27425 those reads are refused. Correct it to match.

## Nit (optional)

- The mapped case is worded differently in the two rules. Align it if it is cheap.

## Holds

The trigger is otherwise exact. The external rule's findings are byte-identical. The managed hint is byte-identical, and the CLI pin uses a managed object. The `PLUMBING` exemption is justified. Changeset: `patch` · `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`. The tests make real assertions. Card #27472's Task reads "an object with `external.writable: true`"; the read-only-binding row widens it by one row on the same fact, as the epic PM's scope call.

Same branch, same claim. The surface stays `packages/lint/src/**` and `.changeset/**`.

epic:#27261#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2c5z3q4h8inrn5kwqV
ACCEPT · PR #27639 @ `78e68ad43b69cdfc71665680aa652e25e3635ccc` · 2026-10-29T16:36Z

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** `security-owd-unset` 不再对 owner 锚点无法证实的外部对象（无声明的 `owner_id` 字段，也无 `external.columnMap` 映到 `owner_id`）推荐 `'private'`：可写绑定给 `security-external-owner-unmapped` 的两条出路，只读绑定（`writable` 非 true，或数据源 `allowWrites: false`）推荐 `'public_read'`。
- **为什么改：** 自 #27425 起，这类对象在 `'private'` 下成员读不到任何行；旧提示会把作者引向一个读空的配置（#27472）。
- **风险与回滚：** 只改 lint 提示文字与 `os explain` 段落；托管对象与 external 规则的输出逐字不变。changeset `patch` · `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`。还原即回滚。
- **先看：** `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts` 的提示选择（~:815-846）与 `validate-external-owner-sharing.ts` 的 `hasUnprovableOwnerAnchor`。
- **两分钟验证：** 单跑 `validate-external-owner-sharing.test.ts` 与 `validate-security-posture.test.ts`。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

席位意见：ACCEPT。独立 Fable 完整复核（`4e9b79ca`）REWORK 两项，本轮 `78e68ad4` 由同一复核者 delta 复核 ACCEPT-with-nits，两项 must-fix 与可选 nit 均已关闭。

## 席位核对

1. **Shape:** +240/−28, all under `packages/lint/src/**` and `.changeset/**`. The reviewer confirmed `hasUnprovableOwnerAnchor` agrees with plugin-sharing's `hasPhantomOwnerAnchor` on `main` for every shape (absent owner, declared owner field, `columnMap` onto `owner_id`, post-injection snapshot). It also confirmed `'public_read'` adds no read filter, so the read-only line is true. The external rule's mapped hint is byte-identical to before.
2. **Premise measured:**
   - the dev's ablation of the read-only arm turns exactly one pin red;
   - the reviewer's own run of the 4 targeted files at `78e68ad4` passes 230;
   - the dev's full lint suite passes 7606 (5 skipped);
   - 58 derived gates ran, 3 NOT-MEASURED left to CI (shallow clone, no full build).
3. **Gate check-runs on `78e68ad4`:** 48 runs: 38 success, 10 skipped, 0 failed or pending. `mergeable_state: clean`.
4. **Accepted deviations:**
   - the read-only-binding row widens the card's Task by one row on the same fact (epic PM's scope call, recorded in the REWORK);
   - the publish gate carries no `datasources`, so a writable binding on an `allowWrites: false` datasource gets the two-ways-out line at the 422 door and `'public_read'` from `os lint`. Neither recommends `'private'`; this is stated in the code comment and the changeset.
5. **Out of scope, carried by the seat:** a read-only binding whose `columnMap` targets `owner_id` on a plugin driver keeps the `'private'` hint, while the runtime notes that predicate may match no row if the driver ignores the map. This is the same `columnMap` diagnostic gap already recorded on the epic; it rides there.
6. **Landing:** not governed (`check-governed-merges --pr 27639`: 268 lines ≤ 3000). No contract face is touched (`Clause-②: no`, no published schema, not governed), so CI plus this read suffices. The domain:spec independent Fable review is on record above. Landed by the seat through the relay.
